programme.desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. They must choose to run and hide, or face the killer whose dark secrets they have just exposed.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: Terrorists kidnap the Russian Prime Minister's two kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant and threaten to blow up a reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in but are no match to a Next Generation UniSol. The world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.desc: The next-door neighbors are having a fight and they send their rude 14-year-old daughter Firni to keep her busy.

programme.title: Dwand
programme.desc: Ruby, a lower-middle-class girl was made to believe that she is beautiful, intelligent, and different and that she deserves a worthy husband. She completed her studies and wanted to be a career girl. However, the marriage happened contrary to her expectations with a traditional man Vivek of the similar lower middle-class strata. After giving birth to a girl child she revolted and joined an advertising company to shape up her career. Here begins the nightmare.

programme.title: Duty
programme.desc: Different classes in society are intertwined, with each person's actions impacting others. When individuals from various classes fulfil their responsibilities, stability is achieved. This story explores fairness and the expression of duty among people from different social strata.

programme.title: Cycle Of Sorrows
programme.desc: Set in a rural village, this heart-wrenching story follows a poor father with a beloved daughter, who still yearns for a son as his pregnant wife prepares to give birth. Driven by financial hardship, he makes a tragic decision that not only shatters his family but leaves his relationship with his daughter and wife forever scarred. Watch this emotional tale of a father’s regret and the lasting impact on his family. Can he undo the damage he’s caused?

programme.title: Electric Piya
programme.desc: A high school girl brings a new bulb for her study lamp. The bulb is anthropomorphic and he is exultant and joyful for having the luck of lighting for her. As he lights, he falls in love with the young girl.

programme.title: Didi!
programme.desc: Imagine waking up to an annoying alarm sound. Familiar? Now imagine waking up to someone else's alarm! Why isn't anyone shutting it? Find out what happens when an annoyed brother wakes up to his sister's loud alarm and storms to her room only to find it empty.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Foul
programme.desc: Against the setting of a journey to Thailand, Ayush, a lustful businessman, possesses both the capability and cleverness to be unfaithful to his wife and shatter her aspirations of moving to Canada. Yet, the question remains: Can he thwart her pursuit of realizing her dreams?

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: Complaint
programme.desc: A journey of a 12-year-old girl who visits the police station to report the disappearance of her bicycle. At the station, a police officer undertakes a heartwarming action to restore the child's trust, earning the admiration and faith of all those present. This incident serves as a powerful testament to our inherent, albeit sometimes unquestioning, belief in the police force.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.title: Gunjaaish
programme.desc: A heartfelt journey of a couple raising a child with autism, discovering the power of love, resilience, and community. Featuring autistic actors, this ground breaking film celebrates acceptance and the beauty of being different.

programme.title: Doughnut
programme.desc: Sameer, on his afternoon break from work, walks into a restaurant hoping for some quiet time. However, a doughnut with supposedly magical properties has him in for a shock. Fearing the unreal powers he suddenly acquires, he hurries out. How does a young woman who walks in right then change Sameer's attitude towards the magical doughnut?

programme.title: Faatima
programme.desc: Faatima is a story of two unknown individuals who meet each other for the first time at a cafe and share with each other some very interesting facts only to make us realize that good souls do exist.

programme.title: Firki
programme.desc: It's the way many father's typically behave when their children start driving. The idea of using the navigation tool to highlight the generation gap is also based on my own life experience. The title is Firki because the family is spinning around like a Firki without having reached their destination in the film. It's also depicts how they've been taken for a ride by the navigation app, or as we say in Hindi....Firki le li

programme.title: Faboo
programme.desc: Are we using social media to expand our horizon or are we overusing it and unknowingly desensitizing ourselves. Faboo explores this aspect of social media and nudges us to think about it through this story of a mother and son.

programme.title: Dhoop Haskar Boli
programme.desc: A determined daughter walks into a matrimonial office with her quiet, circumspect mother. What follows next is an awkward conversation with a charming executive and an inward journey for all three.

programme.title: First Sin
programme.desc: What would you do if you unexpectedly obtain magical powers? Ashwath, a failed businessman is having a troubled relationship with his wife . One fine morning he gets a Sand-timer at his door steps. Life takes a turn when he discovers magical powers in it. Will the Sand-timer be a boon or curse ?

programme.title: Fear Of Wheels
programme.desc: This film beautifully captures the emotional interplay between the vibrant, ambitious youth and the helpless, world-weary elders, showcasing the poignant struggle between generations. As a person reaches a certain stage in life, they observe numerous things happening around them, yet feel incapable of taking action. Over time, they become reliant on others even for the most basic tasks. This narrative portrays those individuals who experience old age gradually tightening its grip around them.

programme.title: Double Blind
programme.desc: A Rendezvous of childhood friends takes place in a dark alley of Mumbai, among the chaos and hustle of the city that never sleeps.

programme.title: Damdi
programme.desc: Damdi, is a story of a young boy. Whose parents left him in childhood, was pampered by her grandmother by working as a babysitter. Damdi has grown up and works in a garage, also studying together. A dear friend Paltan keeps warning him against good and evil. A garage owner Lallan bhaiya acts as a guide. Damdi is in love with a girl Gunja. He has an addiction and attraction towards intoxication, becoming the heart's weakness. Heartbreaks and despairs but returns to a new direction in life again.

programme.title: Destiny's Two
programme.desc: Mohan and his dwarf wife have come to Mumbai from Gujarat for his work. They are a newly wed couple. Their marriage is a compromise, as they do not see the spouse of their imagination in each other. Mohan who gets fascinated seeing taller women realizes the same about his wife. He decides to go to a red light area to fulfill his desire. But does he do it?

programme.title: Chup Chap
programme.desc: Following a newlywed couple enjoying a robust and empathetic bond, their world takes a turn during a party with friends, sparking a profound shift in their perspectives. Despite their differing opinions, both stand firm in their convictions. When an issue deeply troubles the wife, she bravely advocates for justice. After a prolonged battle, legal verdict is achieved. Yet, uncertainties linger about the truth behind this justice, leaving the tale shrouded in ambiguity.

programme.title: Game Of Caste
programme.desc: Game of Caste centers on Rakesh, an ordinary man visiting his aunt in her native village. He's initially captivated by the village's beauty but soon confronts a harsh reality: the mistreatment of a lower-caste boy by the villagers. This revelation shocks him, leading to his determined fight for the boy's rights. The overarching question remains: can he succeed in this battle between humanity and caste discrimination?

programme.title: Days Left Behind
programme.desc: A man struggles to survive in a post-apocalyptic India where the World has been devastated by a deadly virus that turns people into wild cannibalistic creatures, until one day he comes across an abandoned car.

programme.title: Expectations
programme.desc: The story is about a boy grappling with overwhelming feelings and contemplating drastic measures. This growing issue among the younger generation stems from unfulfilled expectations placed by society. 'Expectations' is a short film exploring the theme of emotional struggles and their severe consequences.

programme.title: Perks Of Being An Actor
programme.desc: A relentless pursuit of an aging actor to become a HERO and how these struggles land him in awkward situations.

programme.title: Dum Dum Deega Deega
programme.desc: The solution to your problem is often hidden in the problem itself; all you need is a different outlook. The story of a beggar child, Ajju, who lives on the streets of Mumbai, but dreams big. He challenges his unfortunate fate, with nothing but a 'different outlook' towards the situation he faces.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Even in this modern era, there are several religious conflicts around us. We start judging a stranger based on his/her religion or culture. This short film is a humble attempt trying to reduce the distance between religions and thereby portraying religious bondage.

programme.title: Cheepatakadumpa
programme.desc: ‘CHEEPATAKADUMPA’ follows three women over less than a day as they awaken their naughty teenage alter egos when they meet again after years, unleashing mischief on each other, and in turn on the biased patriarchal belief systems of the world they were born into. In a masculine culture that is unduly serious about making the rules that women are expected to live by, Teja, Santo and Tamanna find true and happy rebellion in the gasping throes of this mischief.

programme.title: Date Night
programme.desc: A meticulously planned date night goes terribly wrong when the husband reveals that he will not be able to make it.

programme.title: Faith
programme.desc: This Young Couple is Super Excited as they just got the permission to go on a night out together but things take an unexpected turn as they get abducted in the middle of the night. The Goons are Brutal on them and it seems that there is no way out until the protagonist thinks of a supernatural idea.

programme.title: Dry Dreams
programme.desc: We mostly don’t care about things, which we have around us and are easily available here’s one such thrilling short film about a guy who has two visitors asking for water, what happens next is an eye opener.

programme.title: Dadi Ka Murabba
programme.desc: Ramesh dreams of a good job but his lack of fluent English hinders him. His Dadi advises him to be self-reliant, prompting him to sell murabba with her help. His business grows, and he asked to raise the flag at his old school on Independence Day. The sarpanch tells him that as a self-reliant young individual, Ramesh can add to the nation's growth. The film shows that it takes both an individual's grit and determination and the support of loved ones to achieve the impossible.

programme.title: Firefly
programme.desc: A chance encounter with a piece from his past, leads Ved, a young man to reminisce a fateful night with his girlfriend, Daaria.

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk
programme.desc: Dawn to Dusk tells the narrative of Nisha Rawat, a young girl who lost her parents. She has skin cancer, Malignant Melanoma and her entire life revolves around the night. Nisha accepted her circumstances as they were. Her life, however, is turned upside down when she meets Suraj, a boy who works at a hospital. Dawn to Dusk becomes Nisha and Suraj's narrative.

programme.title: Dhongbaaz
programme.desc: Upon learning about his bride's unfaithfulness, an anguished groom delves into her past to uncover the truth, all while the wedding guests impatiently await his return.

programme.title: Dream Ride
programme.desc: Dream Ride is an emotional road drama about two strangers, Rajat and Raashi, whose unexpected journey together changes their perspective on life. What begins as a mistaken cab ride gradually unfolds into a heartfelt story of failures, dreams, self-discovery, and second chances. Through humor, honest conversations, and emotional moments along the way, the journey becomes more than just travel — it becomes a rediscovery of hope and the courage to begin again.

programme.title: Silent Cycle
programme.desc:
In a modest Indian household, 12-year-old Vrinda navigates the complexities of gender roles, tradition, and her own budding adolescence. Playful and spirited, she finds herself abruptly thrust into the adult world when she experiences her first menstruation during a Navratri puja. Caught between her grandmother Lata's strict adherence to tradition and her mother Aruna's sympathetic but conflicted support, Vrinda confronts the taboo surrounding menstruation and the use of unsanitary cloth rags.
Determined to change her circumstances, Vrinda takes matters into her own hands, discovering sanitary pads with the help of her younger brother, Jai. However, her newfound confidence is met with resistance from Lata, who views such modern conveniences as unnecessary expenses. This sparks a poignant clash of generations within the family, as Vrinda bravely challenges the stigma surrounding menstruation and advocates for her own health and dignity.
As tensions rise, the family's unity is tested during the Dussehra festival. In a symbolic gesture of reconciliation and progress, Vrinda, Lata, and Aruna come together to burn the effigy of Ravana, marking a small yet significant step towards breaking free from regressive traditions.

programme.title: Happily Married Part 2
programme.desc: Rani & Animesh, a couple who is having an affair with Jimmy plan to meet him on Saturday. The story unfolds as their meeting with Jimmy doesn’t go as planned.

programme.title: Half Cake
programme.desc: HALF CAKE is about a single mother who struggles to earn extra wages to fulfil an innocent ask of a cake from her only son. Beyond the cake, it's a tale of innocence and resilience that will touch your heart.

programme.title: Just Take It Easy
programme.desc: The story is basically on internal happiness. Sanjay a businessman is the CEO of Oberoi Industries. He is not happy in his life. Despite having all the materialistic pleasure not happy internally. The company celebrates its success party on its high growth. Sanjay invites a model Priyanka, his girlfriend to the party. He promises her to make the face of Oberoi Industries.

programme.title: Funkaar
programme.desc: A heart-warming tale of a mother who rediscovers her passion for her craft when her daughter pushes her beyond the confines of her daily routine.

programme.title: Jama Punji
programme.desc: A late night conversation between a mother (Sarla) & her son Anshuman, 13 days after the passing of his father where they discuss the reasons for his detachment with his father and how by the end of the night, certain events lead Anshuman to accept and make amends with his deceased father.

programme.title: Harela
programme.desc: A 60-year-old woman and a young man navigate tradition and modernity during the festival in Uttarakhand. Who will uphold their heritage in an evolving world?

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Hack-her
programme.desc: Shraddha, about to leave for America through a Corporate that is currently under attack by a hacker, who is on run by the police and is currently on every news channel. Between all this is Vishesh, who truly loves Shraddha, and now even she is going, just like his parents, leaving him all alone. But not everything we see is true, a hacker on a mission, a girl with ambitions, and a lover, sounds good right? But who is who? Do we know the entire truth? Find out everything in our upcoming short film "Hack-Her"

programme.title: Ketaki
programme.desc: At dusk in Mumbai, 22-year-old Ava hoped for a moment with her neighbor Harry, who hurried past, preoccupied. At home, Harry revealed stolen cash from a bank robbery. When Aaron demanded the money at gunpoint, Harry shot him dead. Hearing the shots, Ava discovered the scene and, confessing her love for Harry, chose to stay. They buried Aaron, symbolizing a new beginning. As they prepared to flee, Ava's past caught up with them, leading to another gunshot as they escaped, with the haunting "Behri Duniya" playing on.

programme.title: Happy Bhaag Jayegi
programme.desc: Happy elopes with Guddu and breaks her marriage with Bagga, who travels to Lahore to bring Happy back.

programme.desc: Happu Singh, a family man and constable, faces endless struggles that turn his life into a comedy of errors.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is all set to fight Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Gayatri, meanwhile, prays for her husband's safety. Avdesh shows up and confronts Indravadhan. He insults Indravadhan in front of the people gathered at Raj Mahal. Avdesh ties his signature anklet to one of his legs and picks up a spear. Seeing Avdesh armed with a spear, Indravadhan too exchanges his sword with a spear. Will Indravadhan be able to defeat Avdesh Singh Chauhan? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan tends to his wound which got from his battle with Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Gayatri helps him and asks whether is he hurt bad. Indravadhan tells Gayatri that he was hurt when his wife did not trust his capability. Avdesh too gets medicine applied on his wounds and he thinks about Gayatri all this while. Indravadhan meets Avdesh and they discuss about their friendship. Gayatri discusses with Raj Mata about Indravadhan's anger on her. What advice would Raj Mata give Gayatri? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: After the death of Gayatri, Indravadhan declares that he would be leaving Ameerkot. He announces that from now onward Kuwar Singh would be the new king of Ameerkot. When Indravadhan is just about to leave Ameerkot, Kuwar Singh stops him and tells that somebody is more worthy than him to sit on the throne. Indravadhan is put to surprise when Kuwar SIngh tells that Badi Raani Maa would sit on the throne before he could. What will Indravadhan say now? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The crowning ceremony of Badi Raani Maa carries on but before things could slip off Indravadhan's hands, Gayatri shows up in the scene. She then confronts Badi Raani Maa, who is left shocked seeing her alive. A brief argument takes place between Gayatri and Badi Raani Maa and the latter is infuriated seeing the former alive. Badi Raani Maa pulls out a knife and is just about to stab Gayatri. At the same time, Indravadhan throws a spear at Badi Raani Maa which knocks off the knife off of her hand. What will Indravadhan's reaction be after learning the truth of Badi Raani Maa? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan learns that Badi Raani Maa had laid her plans well when she murdered Sulakshana and attempted to murder Gayatri too. Being the king of Ameerkot, Indravadhan gives the verdict where he asks Badi Raani Maa to leave Ameerkot and spend rest of her life as a prisoner in the fort of Rangoon. Badi Raani Maa and Kuwar Singh are shocked hearing Indravadhan's verdict. Indravadhan instructs Badi Raani Maa and says that she would not be allowed to meet her family anymore. Will Badi Raani Maa accept the punishment given to her? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri is searching for one of her books and Indravadhan shows up with the same. Gayatri is angry with Indravadhan and the latter tries to please her. Indravadhan is able to convince Gayatri and a romantic moment breaks out between them. On the other hand, Yashoda visits Raj Mata's court and tells her that Swarnlekha's relationship with a stranger does not seems right. Yashoda later learns that Raj Mata is not in her court and it is Kokila, who is sitting on Raj Mata's chair. What will Kokila's reaction be when she learns that someone is keeping an eye on Swarnlekha? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is surrounded by a group of thugs who have their rifles pointed at him. From a distance, The British officer and Kuwar Singh witness this scene and the latter tells that Indravadhan's rule over Ameerkot is gradually coming to an end. On the other hand, Raj Mata is searching for something among the set of books and at the same juncture, Gayatri arrives. Gayatri tells Raj Mata that is feeling uneasy and fears that Indravadhan seems to be in trouble. Will Indravadhan be able to set himself free from the thugs? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan asks his men to put down their weapons as he realizes that Gayatri's life is in danger. But one of Indravadhan's men shoots him and the goons flee with Gayatri. However, a stranger appears out of nowhere and hears Gayatri in distress. He apprehends the goons, rescues Gayatri and is astonished when Gayatri goes and embraces Indravadhan, who then reaches the place. Later, Rajmata continues to search for Yashodha and Chandravadhan is hopeful that Rajmata remains unaware of the fact that Yashodha is now dead. Just then, Gayatri and Indravadhan enter the scene. How will Rajmata react when she notices their condition? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The man who had saved Gayatri tells to one of his men that his fight for Ameerkot has begun and he is going to fight Indravadhan; defeat him and capture his wife. The following day, the same man visits Ameerkot and stops a ritual that Indravadhan was performing. This act infuriates every member of Ameerkot and Indravadhan asks the man to introduce himself. The man claims himself to be Avdesh Singh Chauhan, the heir of a landlord, who once owned Ameerkot's land. He demands Indravadhan to return Ameerkot back to him. What will Indravadhan's response be to Avdesh Singh Chauhan? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri acknowledges the fact how Indravadhan's grandfather won the land on which Ameerkot stands today. Gayatri decides to stop Indravadhan from fighting the battle for Ameerkot. On the other hand, Kokila and Kuwar Singh think whether this war would bring them personal victory over Indravadhan or a loss for Ameerkot. Later, Gayatri meets Indravadhan to convince and stop him from battling Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Will Indravadhan agree to his wife's request? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Rebel
programme.desc: A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: THE HURT LOCKER is an intense portrayal of elite soldiers who have one of the most dangerous jobs in the world: disarming bombs during the Iraq War.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Rebel
programme.desc: A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

programme.title: Aileen Wuornos: American Boogeywoman
programme.desc: True Story that follows America’s most notorious Female Serial killer. Based on Aileen Wuorno’s early life. Back in 1976 a young Aileen arrives in Florida searching for a new life, marries a wealthy yacht club president to start as part of Florida’s high society. Tormented by her inner demons she surrenders to her murderous impulses havoc in the peaceful community.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Jurassic Hunt
programme.desc: In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, Female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & must work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures and mercenaries hired to finish them off. This battle's about to become primitive.

programme.desc: A group of soldiers attempting to rescue a hostage from a terrorist crash land into unfamiliar jungles which are inhabited by a group of long hidden dinosaurs. Now they must find a way out before becoming prey for prehistoric predators.

programme.title: Rememory

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: A team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated with supernatural powers.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: The Free Fall

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Untraceable

programme.title: Rangoo On The Run
programme.desc: While Baloo chases glutton bird Rangoo for a huge ripe mango, it accidentally falls and the emerald, offered as birthday present to monkey queen Masha by the black cobra which guards the temple ruin treasure, gets caught in it. Baloo is kept hostage, forced to massage the monkey tyrant, while Mowgli follows the bird to return the gem as ransom for his bear friend. Mowgli succeeds and the pair of them even gets to enjoy the lavishly fruit-supplied party.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel’s Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary. Ranveer’s passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani’s lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore’S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore’.Tagore’S Words And Basu’S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. The Show’S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: Respawn
programme.desc: Arun (Vishal Vashishtha) is a former professional gamer, once known as "Flickshot," who left his passion to work a monotonous corporate job and support his family. When he sees his former teammate, Shekhar, succeeding on a massive stage, his suppressed passion resurfaces. Despite his father’s disapproval and the general stigma surrounding gaming as a career, Arun decides to quit his job and attempt a comeback.

programme.title: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Arun realizes he can’t win alone and begins the hunt for a new team. The episode focuses on the recruitment of a "misfit" squad: Prachi: A badminton player struggling with an injury. Jeetu: A delivery boy with natural, lightning-fast reflexes. Adil: A young, tech-savvy enthusiast who acts as the team's initial bridge. Raunak: A volatile but highly skilled "fragger." The task is harder than Arun anticipated, as he has to convince these individuals (and their skeptical families) that they have what it takes to be pros.99999999999

programme.title: Noobde (noobs)
programme.desc: The team has assembled, but the chemistry is non-existent. Raunak’s ego clashes with the other members, and the group struggles to put their personal issues aside during practice. Arun has to step up not just as a player, but as a coach, to teach them that in Esports, individual brilliance is useless without team synergy. This episode highlights the "grind" of professional gaming and the steep learning curve.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: With the tournament only a week away, the pressure reaches a boiling point. Arun’s father discovers he quit his job, leading to a major confrontation. Meanwhile, the team faces a crushing defeat in a practice match against established professionals, leaving their confidence shattered. However, seeing Arun's dedication eventually inspires his father to have a change of heart, and the team finally begins to gel as a unit.

programme.title: Rise Of The Underdogs
programme.desc: The season finale takes place at the Indian Pro Gaming League. Team Clutch enters as the ultimate underdogs. After a shaky start and a brief internal conflict where Raunak almost walks out, the team reunites for a final stand. They reach a thrilling tie-breaker round where they must prove their worth. The series ends with the team securing a victory, using their prize money to chase their individual dreams while planning to build a permanent gaming headquarters.

programme.title: Rangbaaji (the Carefree Persona)
programme.desc: We are introduced to Raviranjan, a small-town guy who balances life as a part-time YouTuber with his status as a "full-time" aspirant. While he acts confident (his rangbaaji), the episode reveals the underlying pressure he faces. He isn’t just seeking a job; he’s seeking the social status required to marry Jyoti. The episode sets up the stakes: it's a battle between his dreams and the harsh deadlines of the competitive exam world.

programme.title: Parishram (the Effort)
programme.desc: The reality check hits hard when the OSC results are announced and Ravi fails his first attempt. He faces taunts from his family and the crushing weight of societal judgment. Encouraged by Jyoti, who provides both emotional support and a strategic plan, Ravi moves from being a "casual" student to a "hardcore" aspirant. This episode highlights the physical and mental "grind" involved in the preparation.

programme.title: Avroh (the Descent)
programme.desc: As the wait for the next exam cycle continues, the "high" of hard work starts to fade into a "low" (Avroh means descent). Financial struggles, family tensions, and unexpected "villains" in the form of societal gatekeepers threaten to derail him. Ravi is forced to make difficult choices between his relationship with Jyoti and his focus on the exam, as the cracks in his mental health begin to show.

programme.title: Prateeksha (the Finale The Wait)
programme.desc: The finale focuses on the most agonizing part of the process: the wait. Ravi faces his final hurdles and a major internal crisis of self-doubt. The episode serves as a powerful commentary on the Indian examination system, exploring whether a job title truly defines a person's worth. It concludes Raviranjan's journey by showing how he manages to reclaim his self-respect (Swabhiman), regardless of the exam result.

programme.title: Humse Na Ho Paayega
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the ultimate "Generation Gap" social experiment. Akash (Rohan Shah) and Pooja (Aditi Myakal) are a modern married couple living in a spacious Mumbai apartment. However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.

programme.title: Khan-Daan
programme.desc: After the initial adjustment period of the pilot, the household faces its first major logistical crisis—Food. The episode explores the chaos of shared groceries, differing diets, and the "disaster" that is a communal refrigerator.

programme.title: Safai-Squad
programme.desc: After weeks of living together, the apartment has reached a state of "critical mess." Aashna (Kriti Vij), who takes pride in a clean and aesthetic home, finally snaps. The episode follows the couple's attempt to militarize the house cleaning process and the bachelors' hilariously lazy resistance.

programme.title: Family Ban Gayi
programme.desc: The episode begins with a sense of impending change. After weeks of chaos, the experimental living arrangement—where a married couple (Akash and Pooja) shares their home with three bachelors (Rohit, Mohit, and Vishi)—is put to the test.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man
programme.desc: As pre-wedding festivities unfold, Aditya stumbles upon a secret only Prajakta’s best friend knew. Can he handle the parts of her he’s just beginning to see?

programme.title: Imperfect Shaadi
programme.desc: The episode centers on the wedding of the lead couple, where everything seemingly goes wrong. However, instead of letting the chaos ruin the day, the couple realizes that the "imperfections" of their wedding reflect the reality of their relationship. They choose to embrace the mess, focusing on their commitment to each other.

programme.title: Certificate Of Nationalism
programme.desc: A satirical take on the idea that love for the country now comes with a “certificate” you must constantly prove.

programme.title: When Your Partner Loves You But Can't Express It
programme.desc: The video portrays relationships where one partner struggles to express love. It highlights the sweet, awkward, and heartfelt moments of unspoken affection.

programme.title: When You Realise Your Younger Sibling Has Grown Up
programme.desc: That surreal shift when your once-tiny sibling starts adulting—and you’re hit by nostalgia and pride.

programme.title: Things Bros Do

programme.title: We All Deserve A Boss Like Him
programme.desc: Here’s the boss who actually gets it: acknowledges your effort, cracks a joke when stress hits, listens when you complain—and makes coming to work less of a drag.

programme.title: If 90s Bollywood Romance Happened Today
programme.desc: The video imagines a 90s Bollywood-style romance—and shows how it would play out today with modern technology and social norms. It contrasts the dramatic, over-the-top declarations and music of old with how things like texting, social media, and everyday logistics change the romance vibe.

programme.title: When You Have A Crush On Your Boss Part 2
programme.desc: The series continues with awkward glances, mis-read messages and “Did they really mean that?!” moments as you try to navigate a crush on your boss in the office. All while pretending you’re just “team-meeting focused.”

programme.title: Holi Special: Story Of 4 Single Friends
programme.desc: The video shows four single friends celebrating Holi together. It highlights their fun, playful banter, and how friendship makes festivals special.

programme.title: Reconnecting With Your School Friends
programme.desc: After years apart, meeting school friends again brings nostalgia, awkwardness, comparisons (life, looks, careers), and the joy of remembering old stories. The video captures that mix of “I remember you” and “what happened to you.”

programme.title: Awkward Moments In College
programme.desc: The video humorously captures the everyday awkward situations students face in college. It highlights embarrassing encounters, funny slip-ups, and relatable campus moments.

programme.title: When Arts Student Falls For Science Student
programme.desc: A charming opposites-attract story that highlights the funny clashes between creativity and logic when an arts student dates a science student.

programme.title: Story Of Every Government Exam Student
programme.desc: A young aspirant juggles coaching, hopes and endless revisions while repeating “Next time for sure!” with every attempt. The video captures the roller-coaster of determination, procrastination and exam stress.

programme.title: Things Only Girl Best Friends Do
programme.desc: From matching outfits, inside jokes, sister-level honesty, to secret plans and shared playlists — this video showcases how girl best friends operate in their own world. Full of loyalty, giggles and codewords.

programme.title: When You're Single And Your Friends Are Dating
programme.desc: The video humorously portrays the dynamics when you're single and your friends are in relationships. It highlights the feeling of being the "third wheel" and the humorous situations that arise from it.

programme.title: Indians At A Tailor Shop
programme.desc: The video portrays the typical experiences and interactions one has when visiting a tailor shop in India. It highlights the common scenarios, misunderstandings, and amusing moments that occur during such visits.

programme.title: Struggles Of Having Long Hair
programme.desc: From endless tangles to hair-in-everything problems—a funny look at the pain of long locks.

programme.title: Planning Your First Time
programme.desc: A funny yet honest portrayal of the nervousness, overthinking, and awkward planning that come with preparing for your “first time.”

programme.title: Things Newly Married Couples Do
programme.desc: This video explores the relatable and often humorous experiences of couples after getting married and the honeymoon phase is over. It highlights the changes in dynamics as they transition from being boyfriend/girlfriend to husband and wife.

programme.title: If Doctors Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A hilarious peek into what would happen if doctors could hear every anxious, dramatic, or random thought their patients have during check-ups.

programme.title: If Exam Subjects Were People
programme.desc: Math, Science, English, and History as human personalities—some annoying, some fun, and all too relatable.

programme.title: When A Topper Falls In Love With A Backbencher

programme.title: 8 Ways Your Partner Drives You Mad
programme.desc: A humorous checklist of those little habits and quirks in your significant other that drive you crazy — from hogging the blanket to weird sleeping positions. All done in relatably exaggerated sketches.

programme.title: When You Can't Go Home For Diwali

programme.title: Thoughts Babies Have
programme.desc: In a baby’s world: “Why am I small? What’s that giant thing called a toy? Where’s my milk again?” — the video imagines the simple but curious internal tongue of a baby. It’s adorable and funny at the same time.

programme.title: When You Are An Only Child
programme.desc: The perks (undivided attention, full bed) and pangs (no sibling backup, solitude) of being an only child — all wrapped in funny, bittersweet moments. It’s a tribute to a life of solo siblinghood.

programme.title: Every Make-Up Lover Ever
programme.desc: From obsessing over blending brushes to dramatic contour fails—this one’s for every beauty enthusiast.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Moves Away (rakhi Special)

programme.title: When Your Partner Cheats On You
programme.desc: The emotional roller-coaster of discovering infidelity: the trust shattered, the shock, the confrontation and the difficult decision of what comes next. Heart-break meets self-reflection.

programme.title: Other Students Vs Me
programme.desc: The video humorously contrasts the habits and achievements of “other students” with your own. It highlights the funny struggles, procrastination, and relatable moments of trying to keep up in school or college.

programme.title: When A Delhi Boy Falls For A Mumbai Girl

programme.title: Story Of Every Ca
programme.desc: The journey of a Chartered Accountant aspirant — sleepless nights, endless revisions, social life sacrificed, and pressure from family & society. It portrays CA life as a tough balancing act between dreams and stress.

programme.title: When You Date A Food Lover
programme.desc: Dates revolve around food, arguments over “where to eat,” and the constant temptation to steal bites from your partner’s plate.

programme.title: Other Couples Vs Us
programme.desc: The video humorously contrasts idealized, picture-perfect couples with the messy, realistic dynamics of everyday relationships. It highlights the funny, imperfect moments that make love authentic and relatable.

programme.title: The Son-In-Law You Deserve
programme.desc: A comedic take on the “perfect” damaad every Indian parent dreams of—respectful, helpful, responsible. But real-life sons-in-law rarely fit this mythical description.

programme.title: When You Go Home After A Long Time
programme.desc: The comfort of maa ke haath ka khana, nosy relatives, and the joy of rediscovering your childhood bedroom.

programme.title: Middle Class Things We All Do
programme.desc: A nostalgic, humorous take on all the small, quirky habits that define being middle class in India – from rationing electricity to bargaining at every shop. It highlights the shared pride and compromises of a “middle class” lif

programme.title: When You Have A Crush On Someone
programme.desc: Every overthinker’s paradise: decoding texts, overanalyzing smiles, and mistaking friendliness for love.

programme.title: Every Exam Preparation Ever
programme.desc: This FilterCopy video humorously captures the chaotic and relatable struggles of exam preparation. Ashish Chanchlani and Viraj showcase every student’s panic, procrastination, and last-minute cramming moments before exams.

programme.title: Moving From A Small Town To A Big City
programme.desc: A heartfelt story about chasing dreams, culture shock, loneliness, and finally finding your place in the chaos.

programme.title: If Your Life Were A Rajinikanth Movie
programme.desc: Over-the-top drama, slow-mo entries, and impossible stunts—because life would be so much cooler with Rajini-style swag.

programme.title: School Lunch Breaks
programme.desc: The video captures the chaos and excitement of school lunch breaks. It highlights the rush, the friendships, and the small adventures that make those moments memorable.

programme.title: When Your Partner Is Annoying But Cute
programme.desc: The video shows all the little annoying things partners do that can drive you crazy. Yet, it highlights how those same quirks make them irresistibly cute and lovable.

programme.title: Friend Vs. Best Friend
programme.desc: The difference between a “friend” and a “best friend”—one borrows your charger, the other your whole life.

programme.title: If Office Were Like School (teachers' Day Special)
programme.desc: A fun reversal where bosses become teachers, projects become homework, and office life feels just like school again.

programme.title: Bhai Vs. Bhai
programme.desc: This FilterCopy video captures the playful rivalry and camaraderie between brothers. Ayush Mehra and Rohan Shah bring to life the humorous, competitive, and teasing moments that define a classic “brother vs. brother” dynamic.

programme.title: Every Dog Lover
programme.desc: The video humorously portrays the unique and often over-the-top behaviors of dog lovers. programme.title: If Salary Were A Person
programme.desc: The video imagines salary as a person in everyday life. It humorously portrays the excitement of arrival and the quick disappearance of money.

programme.title: Breaking Up With Parents

programme.title: Story Of Every Engineering Student

programme.title: Things Women Are Tired Of Hearing

programme.title: When You Have A Girl Best Friend
programme.desc: A funny take on the quirks of having a girl best friend. Shared secrets and playful banter make the friendship unforgettable.

programme.title: When Your Sister Acts Like Your Mom
programme.desc: The video shows how an older sister can sometimes take on mom-like duties—disciplining, caring, worrying—but also still be someone you laugh with and goof around with. It captures that dual role of caregiver + sibling, showing both the annoying and comforting sides of it.

programme.title: Mickey And The Kitten-Sitters

programme.title: Minnie Saves Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: The Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Minnie's Surprise
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy are hired to babysit Clara Cluck's egg, but it begins to hatch on their watch! Follow as the Happy Helpers try to get the mama hen and her egg back together in time.

programme.title: Race For The Rigatoni Ribbon
programme.desc: Mickey and the gang head to Italy to compete in the Race for the Rigatoni Ribbon. Do the Roadster Racers have a chance at winning the race? Follow along with word-for-word narration to find out!

programme.title: A Hot-Dog Day
programme.desc: When Minnie plans a picnic for Daisy and friends, they all pitch in with the help of a misplaced basket.

programme.title: Minnie-rella
programme.desc: The fairy tale is based on the story of Cindrella. Minnie Mouse falls asleep while doing chores and dreams that she becomes Minnierella! She needs help to get ready for Prince Mickey's Grand Ball.

programme.title: Colors All Around
programme.desc: Join Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gane as they search for their favorite colors. Follow along with word-for-word narration and help them find all the colors in the rainbow!

programme.title: Mickey Saves Santa
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends are all ready for a Christmas Eve sleepover at the Clubhouse. They've written their lists and can't wait for Santa Claus to arrive. Santa won't be coming unless he gets some help!

programme.title: Mickey's Easter Hunt
programme.desc: The Clubhouse pals are throwing an Easter party and Pete's upset because he thinks he isn't invited. Pete decides to make a change in the Clubhouse, he makes it disappear-with the friends still inside!

programme.title: Mickey's Halloween Treat
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends want to go to the Tower, for the Halloween party but, they have to get there before the moon is full! Toodles and Mouseketools are what Mickey need to find on his way to the tower.

programme.title: Minnie's Rainbow
programme.desc: In this colorful tale, Minnie Mouse simply explains how these beautiful apparitions are formed. Follow the narration as Minnie and her Clubhouse pals begin to see a world of rainbows around them.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.title: The Guardian Of The Dragon Gem
programme.desc: In Kumandra, Raya, a brave warrior, seeks the last dragon. She gathers a team to restore light and unity to their world. It's a fantasy adventure.

programme.title: Tails, Tricks, And Traps
programme.desc: A fun-filled animated series packed with adventures, pranks, and laughter, showing how characters' mischief creates entertaining, lighthearted, and playful stories.

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Winston the Boston Terrier loves his life with his owner, especially the shared snacks. But a new girlfriend brings healthier food, changing their routine .

programme.title: Vee's Tricks And Treats
programme.desc: Vee celebrates Halloween with tricks and treats. Spooky fun, laughter, and surprises remind her that togetherness makes the holiday truly magical.

programme.title: Ariel To The Rescue
programme.desc: An animated adventure featuring Ariel on a rescue mission, blending courage, kindness, and magical charm, inspiring young viewers with values of bravery and compassion.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Baloo and Bagheera thought Mowgli needed their protection at all times, but Mowgli thought differently. Why, he could fight like a bear and plan like a panther, too! Mowgli tries to save his new friend.

programme.title: Elsa's Gift
programme.desc: Queen Elsa and Princess Anna are hosting a ball for the people of Arendelle. Elsa knows it's the perfect time to show everyone how much she loves her sister. But can Elsa find the right gift for Anna?

programme.title: Starry Night
programme.desc: A beautiful animated Disney tale capturing the magic of nights filled with stars, dreams, and emotions, inspiring wonder and the beauty of imagination.

programme.title: Driven To Win
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen loves racing. But when a new racer arrives, will Lightning still be the fastest car on the track?

programme.title: Lead The Way
programme.desc: Follow along with word-for-word naration as Lightning McQueen discovers the wonders and importance of having a special somebody to help lead the way.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Mater Private Eye
programme.desc: Detective Mater is hot on the trail of a dastardly car-napping! When Tiais sister goes missing, Mater is the only car she can turn to. With this tow truck on the case, anything can happen.

programme.title: Radiator Springs 500 1/2
programme.desc: Lightning and his companions concur that Stanley, the man who founded Radiator Springs. Lightning forced to defend Stanley's honour when Sandy interrupt the festivities and challenge him to a race.

programme.title: A Family Mystery
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Coco is the celebration of a lifetime. Follow along as the discovery of a generations-old mystery leads to a most extraordinary and surprising family reunion.

programme.title: Coco
programme.desc: Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning Land of the Dead following a chain of events.

programme.title: Miguel And The Amazing Alebrijes
programme.desc: Goldie and Bear have fun learning to fly with a lost broomstick. But when the owner is found, they must say goodbye. Read this adorable Disney storybook!

programme.title: Budderball'S First Fair
programme.desc: Budderball is most excited about the food at the town fair: cotton candy, popcorn, peanuts-it all sounds so delicious! When the hungry pup stumbles upon a pie-eating contest.

programme.title: Meet The Buddies

programme.title: The Halloween Visitor

programme.title: A Day with Papa
programme.desc: Explore Disney's read along as Papa Bunny guides Thumper on manners, teaching important lessons through fun adventures with word for word narration and delightful illustrations for children to enjoy.

programme.title: Thumper And The Egg

programme.title: I Love You, My Bunnies

programme.title: Thumper Counts to Ten

programme.title: Grandpa Bunny
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Great Grandpa Bunny Bunny is the ancestral founder of Bunnyville. Follow along with word-for-word narration as he teaches each new generation of bunnies.

programme.title: Meet Fawn The Animal-Talent Fairy
programme.desc: Fawn loves all the animals in Pixie Hollow. When Fawn makes an unusual furry friend, she must prove to the fairies that they can trust this warm hearted beast.

programme.title: New Friends

programme.title: Tink's Treasure Hunt

programme.title: Vidia Takes Charge

programme.title: Tink And The Messy Mystery
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Someone has been going through the fairies'' private things and leaving horrible messes all over Pixie Hollow -- but who could it be?

programme.title: A Perfect Match
